messages.task:
You are a financial analysis assistant tasked with answering questions about a company’s disclosures.  A set of read-only helper tools has been provided.  Use them as needed and show your work when you call a tool.

Scenario description (excerpts from the company’s Form 10-K; numeric amounts tied to internal tables have been removed):
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
… the Office of the Inspector General for the Small Business Administration (SBA) served a subpoena on PNC requesting documents concerning SBA-guaranteed loans originated through a broker named Jade Capital Investments, LLC.  Certain of these loans were referenced in an indictment alleging conspiracy to commit bank fraud and money laundering.  PNC is cooperating with the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of Maryland and, as is its normal practice, cooperates fully with regulatory and governmental investigations.

In addition, PNC—together with parties to whom the bank may owe indemnification obligations—is subject to various pending and threatened legal proceedings.  Management does not currently anticipate that the ultimate aggregate liability arising from such proceedings will have a material adverse effect on PNC’s financial position, although outcomes in individual reporting periods remain uncertain.

Note 24, “Commitments and Guarantees,” discusses several categories of off-balance-sheet exposures, including standby letters of credit that support customer obligations and remarketing programs associated with variable-rate securities.  Standby letters of credit outstanding on December 31, 2013 had terms ranging from less than one year to six years and, in some instances, were secured by customer collateral.  The carrying amount of the liability for standby letters of credit and participations was reported in the consolidated balance sheet.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Available tools:
• list_all_metric_codes() → list[str]
  Return every internal metric_code contained in the database.

• search_metrics_by_keyword(keyword: str) → list[str]
  Perform a case-insensitive search over metric descriptions and return the codes whose descriptions contain the supplied keyword.

• get_metric_metadata(metric_code: str) → (description: str, unit: str)
  Retrieve human-readable information about a particular metric_code.

• get_metric_value(metric_code: str, year: int) → float
  Return the numeric value for the specified metric_code in the given year.

• compute_absolute_difference(a: float, b: float) → float
  Convenience helper that returns |a − b|.

Question:
What was the change in billions in remarketing programs between December 31, 2013 and December 31, 2012?

Please think step-by-step, calling the tools where appropriate, and provide the final answer as a single number (do not include units or additional text).
